title: Dhatarwal - धतरवाल (Jatland Wiki)
creator: Jatland Wiki
what_it_contains: Per WebSearch result summaries only (page returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch; text NOT seen directly): Nathu Dhatarwal b. VS 1380 (1323 AD) at Dhatri (Sujangarh, Churu); after a war with Sinwars left Dhatri with uncle Kalu Dhatarwal and maternal brother Bhinya Ram Roj and settled at Baderan (Lunkaransar area), built ponds and wells; married Rupa Godara, daughter of Narsi Godara of Baderan, VS 1406 (1349 AD) Akshaya Tritiya; died fighting invaders from Sindh on Asoj badi 9 VS 1444 (1387 AD). 'Dhatarwals founded 12 villages': Kumbhana (after eldest son Kumbha), Kheenyera/Khiyana (after second son Khinya), Thoiya (after daughter Thoili, married to Beniwals), Bhanabasti (after Bhana, Nathu's tau), Chudana (after Chuda, Bhana's younger brother), Ajeetmana (after Ajeeta), Nathor/Nathuwas (in memory of Nathu). Khiyana = place of origin of Dhatarwal Jats in Rajasthan; yearly fair for Nathu Dada.
why_relevant: If confirmed, six of the 34 range villages (Kumbhana, Khiyana, Thoiya, Bhanabasti, Ajeetmana, Nathor) form one Dhatarwal founding cluster, and it supports 'Nathor = Nathuwas' as the same unresolved village. The Asoj badi 9 death date matches the Nathu Dada fair date. HIGH PRIORITY for a human to open the page (and its linked pages Kumbhana, Thoiya, Chudana, Nathuwas) in a browser and copy the text and its cited book.
